correctness.rationale: Every asserted eigenvalue derives from the exact second/fourth conditional moments rho and tau, the radial rank-one relation Q=(s²-n)/2, the two standard-coordinate sectors and a Johnson zero-row-sum quadratic sector with adjacency eigenvalues -2 and 1. Their stated multiplicities sum to the full coefficient dimension minus one and all are positive in the exact domain. In square dimensions, evaluating at s=sqrt(n) yields the stated max/min and condition ratio; other allowed offsets differ by at least two, so elementary odd/even branch inequalities prove global strict optimality. Direct matrix tests for n=5..11 and rational checks through m=500 passed 3566 assertions on the actual attached checker; these tests are supporting evidence, not the all-n proof. The remaining single null direction and normalization are explicit.

originality.rationale: The distinct claim is the five-band, one-dimensional-kernel Gram operator for a pair of antipodal Boolean Hamming shells together with a unique globally best-conditioned choice in every square ambient dimension. The closest published one-shell quadratic spectrum does not state or logically yield by special case the two-shell optimization; its single-shell nullity is n+1 rather than one. The joint optimum requires cross-parity spectral comparison across all shell radii. Classical slice basis and block diagonalization methods are fully credited, and an implicit stronger literature theorem remains possible. Searches and full-text material actually inspected support provisional originality, not an absolute priority certificate.
residual_risks: The general Hamming Terwilliger-block spectral theory (Srinivasan and related authors) may implicitly contain the five-level formulas upon specialization; its full body was not exhaustively inspected.

A historical symmetric orthogonal-array or Krawtchouk optimal-design theorem might imply the all-radii square-dimension optimum under another definition; targeted search did not establish full coverage.
This review is same-model only, not independent priority certification.

value.rationale: The two-shell geometry is a natural way to recover degree-two Walsh coefficients lost on a single exact Hamming shell while using only a pair of sampling radii. The finding gives five exact spectral sectors and only one unavoidable radial null direction, then a genuinely global and unique radius selection in every square dimension; its sharp quotient condition approaches one. The 3-wise independent optimum links Fourier reconstruction to symmetric design, providing structural and reproducible experimental-design guidance not supplied by mere rank or a relabelled special case. Exclusions of asymmetric sampling, finite subsampling and higher bands are substantive scope boundaries.
